page.overview:
Who is Aisling Noon?

She is tall with fierce eyes. She is determined.

She is given to swearing in very vulgar Borderlander oaths, doubtless picked up from spending time with soldiers in Shienar.

Aisling has a One Power strength of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. Among the fifty-one sisters taken at the Black Tower, she is the third strongest we have infomation on, just below the de facto leaders Desandre Alraed and Lemai Ambani.

Aisling is 46 years old. She was born in and went to the Tower in . After five years as novice and five as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
